The proposed formula gives Skew(8) = 2^3 + 2^1 = 10 at e = 3. The known count of skew morphisms of Z_8 is 6, which I am recalling from the literature rather than recomputing here. So the formula looks wrong.

The stated final answer, 7.058729051101471, does not match the proposed formula at any integer e. It is also not an integer, so it cannot be a count of skew morphisms.

VERDICT: REJECT
